items.content: Exactly two Jest probes in test/set-value.test.js. Control: setValue({}, 'theme.color', 'dark') returns {theme: {color: 'dark'}}. Exploit: setValue({}, '__proto__.polluted', 'yes') throws an Error matching unsafe key, and a fresh object has no polluted property afterwards. setValue in lib/set-value.js owns key filtering; it is required directly and never mocked.
Settings paths from the preferences API are passed to setValue. A path starting with __proto__ may write onto Object.prototype and change every object in the process.
